description: Return CHECK HOUSE to house vulnerability while retaining CHECK APPETITE for bounded cuisine state

replacements.new:
<ROUTINE V-CUISINE-STATUS ()
    <COND (<EQUAL? ,PRSO ,WHITE-HOUSE>
           <V-HOUSE-RISK-STATUS>
           <RTRUE>)
          (<NOT <EQUAL? ,PRSO ,CUISINE-BODY>>
           <TELL "Only your appetite and stamina have this bounded status." CR>
           <SETG CLOCK-WAIT T>
           <RTRUE>)>
    <CUISINE-ENSURE>
